notes: The Teachable Machine archive supplied for this task contained a TensorFlow Lite model and labels.txt only.
The .tflite model contains embedded TFLite metadata; the embedded metadata identifies the AudioClassifier task and audio preprocessing graph.
This metadata.json is a project-side manifest created from the supplied export. It is not a standalone metadata.json exported by Teachable Machine.
No keras_model.h5 was supplied because the selected Teachable Machine audio export format was TensorFlow Lite. Do not rename the .tflite file to .h5.
